name: Search autocomplete
oneLiner: a frosted white search bar on dark glass: the query types and the suggestion dropdown refills on every keystroke (popular searches give way to the completions, typed part light, completion bold), the arrow key walks a highlight down, the picked row lifts off the list and zips up into the bar, Return lands with a ring of light
say: when the speaker talks about what people are searching for ('type how to automate and look what comes up', 'everyone is searching for this'): the list fills as they set it up, the pick lands on the exact phrase they name
